session.instructions:
An original young adult Japanese female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Distinctive silky-velvet, gently breathy lyric soprano-mezzo with pearlescent clarity and a memorable, melodic cadence. Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "少し気がかりな所見がありますね。". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: Graceful, poised, articulate young female physician with subtle warmth — Thoughtful, composed concern. No music or background noise.
